summary: Ruling 59's one-line fix does exactly what it claims. The BRIDGE back-and-forth blocker from round 3 is gone: 5.58 / 3.25 back-and-forth episodes a game at novice and adept are now 0.00 / 0.04, the same as the live and pre-lane bots. BRIDGE length and structure falls do not move against pre or live, the soak s21 BRIDGE sudden-death gate now passes, and a live BRIDGE check sits at live-bot level. RIFT and FRAY replay round 3 to the last digit in sim and in Chrome, so none of round 3's open items moved. Base defence beats pre only at adept, with veteran inner worse. FRAY stays are 61-66 %, veteran dither is 1.3-1.6, and veteran peel is 70-73 %. RIFT games are 1.2-2.3 min longer than pre, with many more reaching 30:00, and the tactics gate fails 4 or 5 bars. There is no blocker any more and the lane is clearly smarter than the live bots for a player. It does not pass, because items 1, 2, 3, 5 and 7 are unmet. It is not safe to ship under this lane's rule, because pace still regresses against pre. Score 6.5, up from 6.0 because the blocker is cleared.
